answer: A payout is split thus 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The basalt schedule is applied in saffron and fable publishes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3971 identities would post 1267 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
